            # iterate to find a matching link and capture its href
            c = await link_locator.count()
            for i in range(c):
                l = link_locator.nth(i)
                try:
                    text = (await l.inner_text()).strip()
                except Exception:
                    text = ""
                try:
                    href = await l.get_attribute("href") or ""
                except Exception:
                    href = ""
                if target_substr.lower() in text.lower() or "china" in text.lower():
                    match_href = href
                    break
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Fallback: scan articles in main for a heading that contains the full/partial title
    if not match_href:
        try:
            main = page.get_by_role("main")
            if await main.count() > 0:
                articles = main.get_by_role("article")
                a_count = await articles.count()
                for i in range(a_count):
                    art = articles.nth(i)
                    try:
                        # Prefer heading->link pattern
                        if await art.get_by_role("heading").count() > 0:
                            heading = art.get_by_role("heading").first
                            if await heading.get_by_role("link").count() > 0:
                                link = heading.get_by_role("link").first
                                try:
                                    title_text = (await link.inner_text()).strip()
                                except Exception:
                                    title_text = ""
                                try:
                                    href = await link.get_attribute("href") or ""
                                except Exception:
                                    href = ""
                                if target_substr.lower() in title_text.lower() or "china" in title_text.lower():
                                    match_href = href
                                    break
                        # Fallback: first link inside article
                        if await art.get_by_role("link").count() > 0 and not match_href:
                            link = art.get_by_role("link").first
                            try:
                                title_text = (await link.inner_text()).strip()
                            except Exception:
                                title_text = ""
                            try:
                                href = await link.get_attribute("href") or ""
                            except Exception:
                                href = ""
                            if target_substr.lower() in title_text.lower() or "china" in title_text.lower():
                                match_href = href
                                break
                    except Exception:
                        continue
        except Exception:
            pass

    # If we still haven't found an href, the article likely isn't discoverable from the current UI state.
    if not match_href:
        print("No")
        return "No"

    # 4) Navigate directly to the article URL (use relative goto when possible) and inspect images.
    try:
        await page.goto(match_href)
    except Exception:
        # If goto fails, print No and return
        print("No")
        return "No"

    # Wait for the article main region to settle
    try:
        await page.get_by_role("main").wait_for(timeout=5000)
    except Exception:
        await asyncio.sleep(1)

    # 5) Inspect images on the article page for references to 'Shenzhou-20'.
    found = False
    try:
        imgs = page.get_by_role("img")
        icount = await imgs.count()
        for i in range(icount):
            img = imgs.nth(i)
            try:
                alt = (await img.get_attribute("alt") or "").lower()
            except Exception:
                alt = ""
            try:
                src = (await img.get_attribute("src") or "").lower()
            except Exception:
                src = ""
            combined = f"{alt} {src}"
            if re.search(r"shenzhou\s*-?\s*20|shenzhou20|shenzhou", combined, re.IGNORECASE):
                found = True
                break
    except Exception:
        # If role-based image scanning fails, fall back to DOM caption search below
        found = False

    # Additional fallback: search figcaptions/text for the keyword
    if not found:
        try:
            fig_texts = await page.evaluate("Array.from(document.getElementsByTagName('figcaption')).map(e => e.innerText).join('\n')")
            if fig_texts and re.search(r"shenzhou\s*-?\s*20|shenzhou", fig_texts, re.IGNORECASE):
                found = True
        except Exception:
            pass

    result = "Yes" if found else "No"
    print(result)
    return result
